name: [YogaKit] Read View RUM Session

options.monitor_name: [YogaKit] Synthetic Browser: Read View RUM Session

message: Bare page load, no steps — its only purpose is to generate a real RUM session on the read view every 15 minutes so 008's RUM-dependent monitors and SLOs have data pre-launch, before organic traffic exists. Not an uptime check (synthetics/api/read-view-200.json already covers that at a 5-minute cadence) and not an offline-behavior check (synthetics/browser/read-flow-offline.json covers that, paused pending step recording). @syntheticstesting@gmail.com
